content.title: About
content.content: Crackers, rice and nuts is a ready‑to‑eat snack that combines crunchy grain crackers, cooked rice and a mix of nuts. The product offers a light cracker texture, soft rice bites and the nutritional benefits of nuts, making it a convenient option for on‑the‑go meals or work breaks.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The combination is often used in military rations because of its long shelf life.
Nuts may include almonds, cashews or hazelnuts, boosting the content of healthy fats.
Rice is usually pre‑toasted, enhancing flavor and extending shelf stability.
The snack is typically packaged in airtight single‑serve pouches for easy transport.
Crackers are often made from whole‑grain flour, increasing fiber content.

items.title: Source of complex carbohydrates
items.content: Rice and whole‑grain crackers provide slowly digestible carbs for sustained energy.

items.title: Rich in healthy fats
items.content: Nuts contain monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fatty acids that support heart health.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: Nuts supply vitamin E, magnesium, phosphorus and zinc, which aid immunity and metabolism.

items.title: Dietary fiber
items.content: Whole‑grain crackers and rice contribute fiber that promotes regular digestion.

items.title: Plant‑based protein
items.content: Nuts add plant protein, useful for muscle repair and satiety.

items.title: Nut allergy
items.content: The product contains nuts, which can trigger severe allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: High calorie density
items.content: The combination of nuts and starchy components makes the snack energy‑dense, so portion control is advised.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Crackers are often salted; people limiting sodium should choose a low‑salt version.

items.title: Shelf‑life after opening
items.content: Once opened, the snack can lose crispness quickly and become prone to mold if stored in a humid environment.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The snack is ready to eat straight from the pouch. It can be added to salads, used as a base for quick meals, or enjoyed on its own as a portable snack. For a softer texture, nuts can be lightly crushed before consumption.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened package in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, reseal tightly or transfer to an airtight container. For extended storage, keep the snack in the refrigerator to maintain crunchiness and prevent fat oxidation.
